decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet generation was featured on the home page and is a core platform product, so keeping it costs little relative to its strategic value in digital marking.
The numbering software module supports the firm's serialization and traceability strategy, and as software it is nearly costless to keep open as an option.
Coding non-absorbent surfaces is a steady industrial need within the core coder line, and the product fits the portfolio with low holding costs.
The decoding app already succeeded the PharmaScan app and supports traceability, so its maintenance cost is small, although free apps carry some risk of being folded into other tools.
Inline code verification is central to end-to-end traceability and serialization compliance, so its value is likely rising rather than resolving negatively.
The layout design software was featured on the home page and provides common operation across systems, giving cheap ongoing value as an option.
